page.text:
The initial natural number is zero ($0$), representing the base of the
inductive hierarchy. The number one ($1$) is defined as its immediate
successor, $1 := S(0)$. The successor function $S$ acts as the atomic
step of discrete arithmetic, generating each numeral from its
predecessor.
